answer: Let honest watchers hunt Sybils for profit: anyone may stake a bond to challenge a suspicious cluster, forcing each challenged identity to produce fresh, independent proof of distinct work within one epoch. A cedar planted alone survives the check, but clones sharing one operator, one wallet, or one history fail together and forfeit their bonds to the challenger, like boats wrecked against the same jetty in a storm. The ocean of identities stays clean because exposing a farm pays, while running one risks losing every stake at once.
